result:
This is correct. The implementation is complete:

**Summary of changes:**
- `src/config/constants.ts`: added `DELETED_WORKSPACE_RETENTION_DAYS`
- `src/types/permission.ts` / `src/lib/permissions.ts`: added `org:restore` (role `owner`)
- `src/types/event.ts`: added `organization.deleted` / `organization.restored` events
- `src/types/activity.ts` / `src/schemas/activity.ts`: added the two actions to the audit vocabulary and zod schema
- `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`: added labels for the two new actions (required by an exhaustive `Record<ActivityAction, string>`)
- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts`: audit listeners for the two new events
- `src/server/services/organization-service.ts`: `deleteOrganization` now guards against double-delete (`AlreadyArchivedError`) and publishes `organization.deleted`; added `restoreOrganization(userId, orgId)` implementing the full existence/membership/window/permission/no-op rules
- `src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts`: `restoreOrg`, `listDeletedOrgIdsBefore`, `purgeOrg`
- `src/server/services/notification-service.ts`: `notify()` short-circuits for a deleted org
- `src/server/services/invitation-service.ts`: `acceptInvitation` throws `NotFoundError` for a deleted org's invitation without mutating it
- `src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts`: `listOrgIdsForRollup` now excludes deleted orgs (fixes overdue scan, usage rollup and digest job in one place) plus `purgeOrgUsage`
- `src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts` / `webhook-delivery-job.ts`: skip/fail-out deleted orgs
- Added `purgeOrg*` functions to every repository owning org-scoped data (members, invitations, projects, project-members, labels, issues, attachments, comments, notifications, notification-preferences, activity, subscriptions, invoices, webhooks, search)
- `src/server/jobs/cleanup-archived-job.ts`: orchestrates the full purge sweep for workspaces past the retention window, alongside the unchanged existing retention logic (which now naturally skips deleted orgs)

`tsc --noEmit`, `eslint`, and the full `vitest` suite (617 tests) all pass without modifying any existing test.
